newsitem.title: UK: British interest rate rise was prudent - Labour.
newsitem.headline: British interest rate rise was prudent - Labour.

text.p: Wednesday's quarter-point rise in British interest rates was prudent, Gordon Brown, economic spokesman of the main opposition Labour party, said.
But he told Parliament during a debate on the economy that it would not have been necessary if the ruling Conservatives had fostered more investment to increase the economy's manufacturing capacity.

"Prudence is absolutely critical to this economy, which is why the interest rate rise was necessary... but prudent economic management depends for its success on a firm foundation of a strong economy which is investment-rich, and this he has failed to do," Brown said, referring to Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke.
